text.p: Allows you to specify where $PNAME looks for definition files, such as platform definition files, extension files and elf files.

Supported macros are
$$(TraceDir) - The directory containing the current trace. If the trace is a directory type trace, this is the root level of the trace data.
$$(CurrentProject) - The directory containing the settings etc for the current project.
$$(MyDocuments) - The My Documents folder on Windows, ~ or ~/Documents on Linux (depending on distribution).
$$(InstallDir) - The directory where $PNAME is installed.
$$(ENV:<environment variable>) - Allows you to use an environment variable, such as TZ_CFG_PATH. Multiple paths can be specified by separating them with ; (Windows) or : (Linux).
